story: You are a researcher at the Federal Bureau of Prisons analyzing data from the 'Inmate Rehabilitation and Recidivism Study'. This study collects information on various aspects of inmate rehabilitation, including their offenses, sentences, educational backgrounds, and employment statuses, to understand factors that influence recidivism rates and improve correctional programs.
